newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end lower, Telefonica trims gains.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end lower, Telefonica trims gains.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended lower on Tuesday, dulled by losses on other markets and with sharp drops in many key stocks, dealers said.
The general index fell 2.65 points, 0.69 percent, to 379.03 and the Ibex shed 31.44 points, 0.72 percent, to 4,352.18.
Early strength in Telefonica was overturned after news of a Goldman Sachs downgrade based on its high share price. The stock closed up just 5 pesetas at 2,650.

Repsol ended sharply lower amid talk of worse-than-forecast nine-month results. One analyst said weakness in Repsol was simply due to the fact that the stock has risen rapidly off lows earlier this year, and needed to consolidate.
He added that most have been expecting flat earnings this year since the first quarter.
Tabacalera fell a further 4 percent to 4,600 pesetas on expectations Philip Morris to win stake in Portugal's Tabaqueira, intensifying competition for the Spanish firm.
Bourse volume was heavy, with around 7 million shares in Telefonica traded. Turnover totalled 56 billion pesetas.
